Description: Icon-only buttons must expose an accessible label
Do: Set accessibilityLabel or label prop on icon buttons
Don't: Icon buttons without accessible names

Description: All inputs must have a visible label and an accessibility label
Do: Pair Text label with input and set accessibilityLabel
Don't: Inputs with placeholder only

Description: Interactive elements must expose correct roles/traits
Do: Use accessibilityRole/button/link/checkbox etc.
Don't: Rely on generic views with no roles

Description: Async status updates should be announced to screen readers; accessibilityLiveRegion is Android-only, so iOS needs an explicit announcement
Do: Use accessibilityLiveRegion on Android and AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility for iOS
Don't: Update text silently with no announcement

Description: Decorative icons should be hidden from screen readers
Do: Mark decorative icons as not accessible
Don't: Have screen reader read every icon

Description: Touch targets should meet platform guidance: at least 44 by 44 pt on iOS (Apple Human Interface Guidelines) and 48 by 48 dp on Android (Material Design)
Do: Increase padding or hitSlop until the touch area meets the platform minimum
Don't: Small icons with tiny touch area

Description: Adjacent touch targets need enough spacing
Do: Keep visible space between adjacent touchables so their touch areas do not overlap
Don't: Cluster many buttons with no gap

Description: Custom gestures must not break system scroll/back
Do: Reserve horizontal swipes for carousels
Don't: Full-screen custom swipe conflicting with back
Code Example Bad: PanResponder on full screen blocking back

Description: Back navigation should be predictable and preserve state
Do: Use navigation.goBack and keep screen state
Don't: Reset stack or exit app unexpectedly

Description: Bottom navigation is for a small set of top-level destinations; Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design both describe three to five
Do: Keep three to five top-level destinations and move the rest into another surface
Don't: Overloaded tab bar with many icons

Description: Modals/sheets must have clear close actions
Do: Provide close button and swipe-down where platform expects
Don't: Trapping users in modal with no obvious exit

Description: Returning to a screen should restore its scroll and form state
Do: Keep screens mounted (the default) or persist scroll and form state outside the screen
Don't: Discard screen state on every tab switch
Code Example Good: <Tab.Navigator> with default options; scroll and draft state kept in a store
Code Example Bad: Screens rendered as null when unfocused, losing scroll and form input

Description: Show visible feedback during network operations
Do: Use ActivityIndicator or a skeleton for waits users notice
Don't: Leave button and screen frozen
Code Example Bad: <Button title="Save" onPress={submit} /> with no loading state

Description: Confirm successful actions with brief feedback
Do: Show toast/checkmark or banner
Don't: Complete actions silently with no confirmation

Description: Show clear error messages near the problem
Do: input-level error + summary banner
Don't: Only change border color with no explanation

Description: Validate inputs on blur or submit with clear messaging
Do: Validate onBlur and onSubmit
Don't: Validate on every keystroke causing jank

Description: Use appropriate keyboardType and returnKeyType
Do: Match email/tel/number/search types
Don't: Use default keyboard for all inputs

Description: Guide users through form fields with Next/Done flows
Do: Use onSubmitEditing to focus next input
Don't: Force users to tap each field manually

Description: Allow toggling password visibility securely
Do: Provide Show/Hide icon toggling secureTextEntry
Don't: Force users to type blind with no option

Description: Use FlatList/SectionList for lists over ~50 items
Do: Use keyExtractor and initialNumToRender appropriately
Don't: Render hundreds of items with ScrollView

Description: Use correctly sized and cached images
Do: Use Image component with proper resizeMode and caching
Don't: Load full-resolution images everywhere

Description: Debounce scroll/search callbacks to avoid jank
Do: Wrap handlers with debounce/throttle
Don't: Run heavy logic on every event

Description: No duration or easing curve is universally correct; review motion against the platform's native transitions and the purpose of the change
Do: Define named motion tokens, review them in the rendered interaction, and run animations on the native driver where possible
Don't: Hard-code one long or linear animation for every state change
Code Example Good: Animated.timing(value, { toValue: 1, duration: motion.short, easing: motion.standard, useNativeDriver: true })

Description: Respect OS reduced-motion accessibility setting
Do: Check reduceMotionEnabled and simplify animations
Don't: Ignore user motion preferences

Description: Reserve infinite animations for loaders and live data
Do: Use looping only where necessary
Don't: Keep decorative elements looping forever

Description: Body text must stay readable and scale with the system text-size setting
Do: Use a type ramp that scales with fontScale and test at the largest accessibility sizes
Don't: Small fixed sizes that ignore the user's setting

Description: Support system text scaling without breaking layout
Do: Set allowFontScaling and test large text
Don't: Disable scaling on all text globally

Keywords: safe area insets notch gesture react-native-safe-area-context
Description: Content must not overlap notches/gesture bars
Do: Apply insets with react-native-safe-area-context (the built-in SafeAreaView is deprecated and iOS-only)
Don't: Place tappable content under system bars
Code Example Bad: <View style={{ flex: 1 }}> with tappable content under the status bar

Description: Ensure sufficient contrast in both light and dark themes
Do: Use semantic color tokens resolved per theme and measure each text and background pair in both themes
Don't: Reuse light-theme grays directly in dark mode
Code Example Good: colors.text.primary resolved per theme and measured against colors.surface
Code Example Bad: Light-theme gray reused unchanged on a dark surface

Description: Don't rely solely on hidden gestures for core actions
Do: Provide visible buttons in addition to gestures
Don't: Rely on swipe/shake only with no UI affordance
Code Example Good: Swipe to delete + visible Delete button
Code Example Bad: Only shake device to undo with no UI
